sources: JRC EUR 27346 'Design of Joints' worked examples (free, DOI 10.2788/605700)
ndp_note: Rules with ndp:true are Nationally Determined Parameters — the values are the EN 1993-1-8:2005 recommended (boxed) values; a country National Annex may set different values.

rules.rule: Minimum end distance e1 (parallel to load direction)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 1.2: e1 min = 1.2d0 (EN 1993-1-8:2005 Table 3.3)

rules.rule: Minimum edge distance e2 (perpendicular to load direction)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 1.2: e2 min = 1.2d0; NOTE pre-2005 ENV gave 1.5d0 — superseded

rules.rule: Minimum distance e3 to end of slotted hole (parallel direction)
rules.source_quote: EN Table 3.3: for slotted holes e3 and e4 ≥ 1.5d0 to the slot end/edge

rules.rule: Minimum distance e4 to edge of slotted hole (perpendicular direction)
rules.source_quote: EN Table 3.3: e4 ≥ 1.5d0 to slotted-hole edge

rules.rule: Minimum bolt pitch p1 in the direction of load
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 1.2: p1 min = 2.2d0

rules.rule: Minimum bolt pitch p2 perpendicular to load direction
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 1.2: p2 min = 2.4d0

rules.rule: Maximum end/edge distance e1/e2 — parts exposed to weather or corrosion
rules.units: mm (t = thickness of thinner outer part)
rules.source_quote: EN Table 3.3: e1, e2 max = 4t + 40 mm for exposed parts

rules.rule: Maximum end/edge distance e1/e2 — parts not exposed to weather
rules.units: mm (t = thickness of thinner outer part)
rules.source_quote: EN Table 3.3: e1, e2 max = max(8t, 125 mm) for non-exposed parts

rules.rule: Maximum bolt pitch p1/p2 — outer rows
rules.units: mm (t = thickness of thinner outer part)
rules.source_quote: EN Table 3.3: p1 and p2 max = min(14t, 200 mm) for outer rows

rules.rule: Maximum bolt pitch p1 — inner rows in direction of compression
rules.source_quote: EN Table 3.3: inner rows, compression direction: p1 max = min(28t, 400 mm)

rules.rule: Maximum pitch for weathering steel (EN 10025-5) — replaces 200 mm cap
rules.source_quote: EN Table 3.3 note: for weathering steel, 200 mm limit replaced by 175 mm

rules.rule: Standard clearance hole — bolt diameter M12 or M14
rules.source_quote: EN 1090-2 Table 11: M12, M14 → nominal hole diameter d0 = d + 1 mm

rules.rule: Standard clearance hole — bolt diameter M16 to M24
rules.source_quote: EN 1090-2 Table 11: M16–M24 → d0 = d + 2 mm (e.g. M20 → 22 mm hole)

rules.rule: Standard clearance hole — bolt diameter M27 and above
rules.source_quote: EN 1090-2 Table 11: M27+ → d0 = d + 3 mm (e.g. M27 → 30 mm hole)

rules.rule: Oversized hole clearance — bolt diameter M12
rules.source_quote: EN 1090-2 Table 11: M12 oversized → +3 mm clearance

rules.rule: Oversized hole clearance — bolt diameter M14 to M22
rules.source_quote: EN 1090-2 Table 11: M14–M22 oversized → +4 mm clearance

rules.rule: Oversized hole clearance — bolt diameter M24
rules.source_quote: EN 1090-2 Table 11: M24 oversized → +6 mm clearance

rules.rule: Oversized hole clearance — bolt diameter M27 and above
rules.source_quote: EN 1090-2 Table 11: M27+ oversized → +8 mm clearance

rules.rule: Bolt joint category A — bearing type, shear connection (non-preloaded)
rules.source_quote: EN §3.4.1: Category A — no slip criterion; bolt may be non-preloaded; governed by Fv,Rd and Fb,Rd

rules.rule: Bolt joint category B — slip-critical at SLS, shear connection (preloaded)
rules.source_quote: EN §3.4.1: Category B — preloaded bolt (8.8/10.9); Fs,Rd,ser must not be exceeded at SLS

rules.rule: Bolt joint category C — slip-critical at ULS, shear connection (preloaded)
rules.source_quote: EN §3.4.1: Category C — preloaded bolt (8.8/10.9); Fs,Rd must not be exceeded at ULS; also check Fnet,Rd

rules.rule: Bolt joint category D — non-preloaded, tension connection
rules.source_quote: EN §3.4.2: Category D — bolt in tension, non-preloaded; governed by Ft,Rd

rules.rule: Bolt joint category E — preloaded, tension connection
rules.source_quote: EN §3.4.2: Category E — bolt in tension, preloaded; governed by Ft,Rd per §3.9

rules.rule: Bolt preload force Fp,C
Characteristic slip factor μ — friction Class A (blasted surface)
rules.source_quote: EN 1090-2 Table 18: Class A — surfaces blasted to Sa 2½ or hot-dip galvanised and wire-brushed → μ = 0.50

rules.rule: Characteristic slip factor μ — friction Class B (blasted + zinc silicate)
rules.source_quote: EN 1090-2 Table 18: Class B — blasted + alkali zinc silicate primer → μ = 0.40

rules.rule: Characteristic slip factor μ — friction Class C (wire brushed or flame cleaned)
rules.source_quote: EN 1090-2 Table 18: Class C — wire brushed or flame cleaned → μ = 0.30

rules.rule: Characteristic slip factor μ — friction Class D (as-rolled)
rules.source_quote: EN 1090-2 Table 18: Class D — as-rolled (no surface treatment) → μ = 0.20

rules.rule: Hole factor ks — standard clearance holes
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 1.3: ks = 1.00 for normal (standard clearance) holes

rules.rule: Hole factor ks — oversized or short slotted holes perpendicular to load
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 1.3: ks = 0.85 for oversized or short slotted (perpendicular to load)

rules.rule: Hole factor ks — long slotted holes perpendicular to load
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 1.3: ks = 0.70 for long slotted holes perpendicular to load

rules.rule: Hole factor ks — short slotted holes parallel to load
rules.source_quote: EN Table 3.6: ks = 0.76 for short slotted holes parallel to load direction

rules.rule: Hole factor ks — long slotted holes parallel to load
rules.source_quote: EN Table 3.6: ks = 0.63 for long slotted holes parallel to load direction

rules.rule: Shear coefficient αv — shear plane through shank (all bolt classes)
rules.units: dimensionless (use with gross area Ag = πd²/4)
rules.source_quote: EN §3.6.1(1): αv = 0.6 if shear plane passes through the unthreaded shank (A = Ag)

rules.rule: Shear coefficient αv — shear plane through threads, bolt class 8.8 or 10.9
rules.units: dimensionless (use with tensile stress area As)
rules.source_quote: EN §3.6.1(1): αv = 0.6 for classes 8.8 and 10.9 when shear through threaded part (A = As)

rules.rule: Shear coefficient αv — shear plane through threads, bolt class 4.6 (also 5.6, 6.8)
rules.units: dimensionless (use with tensile stress area As)
rules.source_quote: EN §3.6.1(1): αv = 0.5 for classes 4.6, 5.6 and 6.8 when shear through threaded part (A = As)

rules.rule: Effective throat a as fraction of leg length s
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Ex.1.3: effective throat a = 0.7s (45° fillet, s = leg length)

rules.rule: Fillet weld design resistance per unit length (directional method)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Ex.1.3: Fw,Rd = fvw,d × a (EN §4.5.3.2 directional method)

rules.rule: Weld design shear strength fvw,d (directional method, Eq. 4.1)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Ex.1.3: fvw,d = fu/(√3 × βw × γM2) — fu from EN 1993-1-1 Table 3.1; γM2 NDP

rules.rule: Weld correlation factor βw for steel grade S235
rules.source_quote: EN Table 4.1: S235 → βw = 0.80, fu = 360 N/mm² (EN 1993-1-1 Table 3.1)

rules.rule: Weld correlation factor βw for steel grade S275
rules.source_quote: EN Table 4.1: S275 → βw = 0.85, fu = 430 N/mm² (EN 1993-1-1 Table 3.1, t≤40mm); NOTE: UK P358 uses 410 N/mm² (EN 10025-2 minimum) — UK agent gives UK values

rules.rule: Weld correlation factor βw for steel grade S355
rules.source_quote: EN Table 4.1: S355 → βw = 0.90, fu = 510 N/mm² (EN 1993-1-1 Table 3.1, t≤40mm); NOTE: UK P358 uses 470 N/mm²

rules.rule: Weld correlation factor βw for steel grade S420 (N/NL/M/ML)
rules.source_quote: EN Table 4.1: S420 N/NL/M/ML → βw = 1.00, fu = 520 N/mm²

rules.rule: Weld correlation factor βw for steel grade S460 (N/NL/M/ML/Q/QL/QL1)
rules.units: dimensionless (with fu ≈ 540–550 N/mm², grade and thickness dependent)
rules.source_quote: EN Table 4.1: S460 N/NL/M/ML/Q/QL/QL1 → βw = 1.00; fu varies by EN 10025-3/4/6 product

rules.rule: Design fu for S235 used in weld design (EN 1993-1-1 Table 3.1, t ≤ 40 mm)
rules.citation: EN 1993-1-1:2005 Table 3.1 as used in EN 1993-1-8 Table 4.1 (JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S235 fu = 360 N/mm² (t ≤ 40 mm)

rules.rule: Design fu for S275 used in weld design (EN 1993-1-1 Table 3.1, t ≤ 40 mm)
rules.citation: EN 1993-1-1:2005 Table 3.1 as used in EN 1993-1-8 Table 4.1 (JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S275 fu = 430 N/mm² (t ≤ 40 mm) — UK P358 uses 410 from EN 10025-2 minimum

rules.rule: Design fu for S355 used in weld design (EN 1993-1-1 Table 3.1, t ≤ 40 mm)
rules.citation: EN 1993-1-1:2005 Table 3.1 as used in EN 1993-1-8 Table 4.1 (JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S355 fu = 510 N/mm² (t ≤ 40 mm) — UK P358 uses 470 from EN 10025-2 minimum

rules.rule: Minimum effective length of a fillet weld
rules.source_quote: EN §4.5.1: fillet weld effective length shall not be less than max(6a, 30 mm)

rules.rule: Partial factor γM0 — cross-section resistance (EN recommended value, NDP)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 §1.2.1: γM0 = 1.00 (EN recommended); NDP — verify with country NA

rules.rule: Partial factor γM1 — member instability (EN recommended value, NDP)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 §1.2.1: γM1 = 1.00 (EN recommended); NDP — verify with country NA

rules.rule: Partial factor γM2 — bolts, welds, pins, plates in bearing (EN recommended value, NDP)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 §1.2.1: γM2 = 1.25 (EN recommended for connectors); NDP — some NAs split bolt/weld from net-section fracture

rules.rule: Partial factor γM3 — slip resistance at ULS (EN recommended value, NDP)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 §1.2.1: γM3 = 1.25 (EN recommended, ULS slip); NDP — verify with country NA

rules.rule: Partial factor γM3,ser — slip resistance at SLS (EN recommended value, NDP)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 §1.2.1: γM3,ser = 1.10 (EN recommended, SLS slip); NDP — verify with country NA

rules.rule: S235 nominal yield strength fy for t ≤ 16 mm
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S235 fy = 235 N/mm² for t ≤ 16 mm

rules.rule: S235 nominal yield strength fy for 16 mm < t ≤ 40 mm
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S235 fy = 225 N/mm² for 16 < t ≤ 40 mm

rules.rule: S235 nominal tensile strength fu for t ≤ 40 mm
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S235 fu = 360 N/mm² (t ≤ 40 mm)

rules.rule: S275 nominal yield strength fy for t ≤ 16 mm
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S275 fy = 275 N/mm² for t ≤ 16 mm

rules.rule: S275 nominal yield strength fy for 16 mm < t ≤ 40 mm
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S275 fy = 265 N/mm² for 16 < t ≤ 40 mm

rules.rule: S275 nominal tensile strength fu for t ≤ 40 mm (EN 1993-1-1 Table 3.1 design value)
rules.citation: EN 1993-1-1:2005 Table 3.1 (JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1; EN 1993-1-8 Table 4.1 βw corr.)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S275 fu = 430 N/mm² (t ≤ 40 mm) — this is EN 1993-1-1 Table 3.1 nominal; EN 10025-2 minimum is 410 N/mm²

rules.rule: S355 nominal yield strength fy for t ≤ 16 mm
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S355 fy = 355 N/mm² for t ≤ 16 mm

rules.rule: S355 nominal yield strength fy for 16 mm < t ≤ 40 mm
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S355 fy = 345 N/mm² for 16 < t ≤ 40 mm

rules.rule: S355 nominal tensile strength fu for t ≤ 40 mm (EN 1993-1-1 Table 3.1 design value)
rules.citation: EN 1993-1-1:2005 Table 3.1 (JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1; EN 1993-1-8 Table 4.1 βw corr.)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S355 fu = 510 N/mm² (t ≤ 40 mm) — EN 10025-2 minimum is 470 N/mm²

rules.rule: S420 nominal yield strength fy for t ≤ 16 mm
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S420 (N/NL/M/ML) fy = 420 N/mm² for t ≤ 16 mm

rules.rule: S420 nominal yield strength fy for 16 mm < t ≤ 40 mm
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S420 fy = 400 N/mm² for 16 < t ≤ 40 mm

rules.rule: S420 nominal tensile strength fu for t ≤ 40 mm
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S420 fu = 520 N/mm² (t ≤ 40 mm)

rules.rule: S460 nominal yield strength fy for t ≤ 16 mm
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S460 (N/NL/M/ML/Q/QL/QL1) fy = 460 N/mm² for t ≤ 16 mm

rules.rule: S460 nominal yield strength fy for 16 mm < t ≤ 40 mm
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S460 fy = 440 N/mm² for 16 < t ≤ 40 mm

rules.rule: S460 nominal tensile strength fu for t ≤ 40 mm (grade-dependent EN 10025-3/4/6)
rules.citation: EN 1993-1-1:2005 Table 3.1 (JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1; verify against EN 10025-3/4/6)
rules.source_quote: JRC EUR 27346 Table 0.1: S460 fu ≈ 540 N/mm² (N/NL/M/ML) to 550+ (Q/QL/QL1); verify product standard
